problem.text: Perplexity-only evaluation unconditionally divided by a zero KLD count and left collect_logits undefined when no reference filename was supplied.

reasoning.text: The two guards work together: initializing collect_logits prevents an undefined-variable access, while conditioning KLD finalization on logits_file avoids the zero-denominator calculation. Either edit alone would leave the no-reference path broken.

impact.text: For valid nonempty evaluation data, the patched no-reference path can finalize perplexity without calculating, printing or returning KLD. Reference collection and comparison remain available.

source_notes.text: Read the reference-logit introduction entry and the later mask/cache entry. They record the no-reference failure and establish that cache invalidation had already been repaired before this task.
Parent source plus the task diff show that the recorded no-reference failure is removed, the three-argument cache invalidation remains, and filtering can still exclude a required reference producer.

limitations: No model inference, GPU execution, cache access or safetensors round trip was executed; the arithmetic check is a scalar transcription, not execution of test_ppl.
The new tokenizer directory's availability and tokenizer compatibility with evaluated models are unestablished.
The evidence does not establish an empirical rationale for the inherited ten-row KLD cap.

chapters.title: Make reference-logit evaluation optional at finalization

claims.text: main supplies logits_file only when a model specification contains out_logits; --kld selects the plotted metric rather than enabling collection. Whole-tree search finds main as the sole direct test_ppl caller.

Perplexity calculation moves outside the ProgressBar context but remains after the row loop. KLD calculation and printing become conditional on logits_file. collect_logits defaults to false, so a perplexity-only run skips saving reference tensors; the result already conditionally included kld.

The inherited KLD branch processes at most ten sequence rows. Reference collection increments its count without accumulating divergence, yielding zero for a nonempty reference run. Comparison accumulates divergence over output positions; perplexity instead uses shifted next-token targets across all rows. These metric definitions are unchanged.

A standard-library transcription reproduced the parent's zero-over-zero failure. With synthetic log-probability sum −6 and count 3, patched finalization produced perplexity 7.389056 without KLD; synthetic reference and comparison cases produced KLD 0 and 0.5 respectively.

The example data specification changes tokenizer_dir from /mnt/str/eval_models/llama3.2-1b/hf/ to /mnt/str/models/llama3.2-1b-instruct/hf/. get_test_data passes this value to tokenize_transformers, which loads AutoTokenizer from that directory. This selects tokenizer assets, not model weights, and is not a precondition of the finalization repair.

findings.description: The inherited mask path can retain reference consumers while excluding their producer; this task does not change that dependency.
findings.trigger: A mask excludes the out_logits producer, retains an uncached candidate, and the selected reference file is absent.
findings.expected_behavior: Generate the reference or reject the missing dependency before evaluating the candidate.
findings.actual_behavior: main retains logits_file after filtering; test_ppl loads the candidate and then attempts to open the absent reference through load_tensor.

verification.description: Compared parent reference discovery, filtering and loading with the complete task diff. Whole-tree test_ppl search found main as its only direct caller.
verification.limits: No filesystem-library behavior was executed. Existing reference files or cached candidate results avoid this trigger; external caller reach is not established.

annotation.summary: Repairs perplexity-only finalization by guarding optional KLD work and initializing reference collection state; also updates an example tokenizer path.
